notes: Sample dispatch email: new template 'Sample dispatch (cover letter)' in Settings → Email templates — same words as the cover letter plus the tracking number and tracking link, all editable. Switch inside the template: send it by itself when a tracking number is entered or changed (5 minutes later, once per number). ✉ Email button on each dispatch in Marketing → Enquiries to send or edit it by hand. New Master → Logistics → Postage & Couriers: courier name, website and tracking link with {tracking_no}; 'Find the tracking link on the website' looks it up online, else it stays blank and the general 17track link is used. Couriers here are the Marketing 'Sent by' list.
